tests.title: Works with the example
tests.fail_why: Ni el ejemplo del enunciado funciona.
tests.fail_how: Traza a mano {1200,350,899,4500} con saldo 1550 antes de enviar.
tests.fail_why_en: Not even the statement's example works.
tests.fail_how_en: Trace {1200,350,899,4500} with balance 1550 by hand before submitting.

tests.title: Does not reuse the same index (e.g. [500,500] with balance 1000)
tests.fail_why: Reutilizas el mismo elemento dos veces, o fallas con valores repetidos.
tests.fail_how: En el HashMap guarda el elemento DESPUÉS de revisar si existe su complemento; así nunca te encuentras a ti mismo.
tests.fail_why_en: You reuse the same element twice, or you fail with repeated values.
tests.fail_how_en: In the HashMap, store the element AFTER checking whether its complement exists; that way you never find yourself.

tests.title: Works with negative numbers
tests.fail_why: Falla con negativos o saldo cero.
tests.fail_how: No asumas valores positivos ni ordenados; el complemento target - x puede ser negativo. Con HashMap no importa.
tests.fail_why_en: Fails with negative numbers or a zero balance.
tests.fail_how_en: Do not assume positive or sorted values; the complement balance - x can be negative. With a HashMap it does not matter.

tests.title: Throws IllegalArgumentException when there is no solution
tests.fail_why: No lanzaste IllegalArgumentException cuando no hay solución (devolviste null, [] u otra cosa).
tests.fail_how: Al terminar el ciclo: throw new IllegalArgumentException("No solution"). Las reglas del enunciado son parte del contrato.
tests.fail_why_en: You did not throw IllegalArgumentException when there is no solution (you returned null, [] or something else).
tests.fail_how_en: After the loop: throw new IllegalArgumentException("No solution"). The rules in the statement are part of the contract.

tests.title: O(n): works with 200,000 elements in reasonable time
tests.fail_why: Dos ciclos anidados son O(n²): con 200 mil elementos son 20 mil millones de comparaciones.
tests.fail_how: Un solo pase con HashMap complemento -> índice: O(n) tiempo y O(n) espacio. Intercambias memoria por velocidad.
tests.fail_why_en: Two nested loops are O(n²): with 200 thousand elements that is 20 billion comparisons.
tests.fail_how_en: A single pass with a HashMap complement -> index: O(n) time and O(n) space. You trade memory for speed.
